regions.merged_text: Hoping that my tardiness in answering your letters early in December may not scandalize, I am trying these few days to makd up for lost time - three in-a-row. I hoped to get one of those "Begone S." I know I had a couple of them in Brooklyn, but whether or not they put them in or if I can find them now among other things I am not certain. Till shortly before Christmas I was continually getting behind in my correspondence; though others helped me now and then. Now, thank God Fr.Michael, one of my former altar boys from Pitt Street I. Y. and now one of our missionaries helps me when not away. However, I am going to try and get a copy of that booklet for you. I must have one somewhere I am trying to get this off Air-special so as if possible to overtake the one I mailed you yesterday without name of comment regular mail. As to that $20. check, of Dec. 10th: not knowing what you might want me to do with it, I am enroling the Poor Holy Souls for your intion. - at least till further instructed, - i.e. 310. of it.
